div.div: PATH A: TIGHT DISTRIBUTED COUPLING (SYNCHRONOUS RPC & SHARED DB)

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 351px; margin-left: 59px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #1E293B;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#1E293B, #c3ccdc); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: nowrap;

div.div:
• Temporal Lockstep: Caller and callee must be available and executing simultaneously
• Spatial Dependency: Caller must hardcode physical IP, host, and port network addresses
• Schema Entanglement: Shared tables and DB locks create cascading deadlock contention
• Failure Cascades: Downstream latency spikes exhaust caller thread pools (Little's Law)
[!] Architectural Consequence: Outages in any downstream service trigger total system failure

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 242px; margin-left: 769px;

div.div: PATH B: DECOUPLED ENTERPRISE MESSAGING BACKBONE (CHANNELS & PIPES)

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 351px; margin-left: 779px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #1E293B;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#1E293B, #c3ccdc); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: nowrap;

div.div:
• Temporal Decoupling: Store-and-forward channel buffers isolate producers from consumers
• Spatial Independence: Messages route to logical channel names, not server host addresses
• Contract Isolation: Typed envelopes hide internal databases behind explicit event schemas
• Elastic Traffic Smoothing: Transient arrival spikes absorb safely into durable queues
[✓] Architectural Consequence: Systems degrade gracefully; zero cascading worker thread pileups

• Decoupled Invariant: Each filter executes independently with zero knowledge of upstream sources or downstream targets.
• Composable Extensibility: Additional filters (auditing, encryption, rate-limiting) insert cleanly without modifying business endpoints.
